name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Government-backed guaranteed pension scheme for all Indian citizens, primarily targeted at unorganized sector workers, providing a fixed monthly pension from age 60.

benefit.description: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month from age 60 until death, followed by same pension to spouse, and return of full pension corpus to nominee.

general: Open to all Indian citizens having a savings bank account or post office account
Age between 18 and 40 years at the time of entry
Monthly auto-debit facility from bank account must be maintained
otherConditions: Income tax payers are not eligible to join APY (as per government notification)

eligibilityChecks.question: Are you between 18 and 40 years of age?
Do you hold an active Savings Bank or Post Office account for monthly auto-debit?
Are you a non-taxpayer (not filed/paid income tax)?

requiredDocuments: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account Passbook
Active Mobile number linked to bank account
applicationProcess: Visit your bank branch, post office, or log in to Net Banking / Mobile Banking app
Fill APY Registration Form and choose desired pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000/month)
Set up monthly auto-debit consent; bank generates Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) Card
Download APY e-PRAN card from NSDL / Protean portal (npscra.nsdl.co.in)

applicationWindow.details: Enrollment open throughout the year at all banks

verification: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
aiContext: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60 for citizens joining between 18-40 years. Modest monthly contributions auto-debited from bank account. Taxpayers excluded.

faqs.question: What happens after the subscriber's death after age 60?
faqs.answer: The exact same pension amount is paid to the spouse for life. After the demise of both, the accumulated corpus is returned to the nominee.

faqs.question: Can I increase or decrease my pension amount later?
faqs.answer: Yes, subscribers can change their pension tier (e.g. from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000) once every financial year in April.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign initiative offering a government-backed high-interest savings scheme exclusively for the education and marriage of the girl child.

benefit.amount: High Sovereign Interest (8.2% p.a.) + 100% Tax Exemption (EEE)
benefit.description: Attractive 8.2% annual interest rate (highest among small savings). Maximum deposit ₹1.50 Lakh per financial year. Complete tax exemption under Section 80C on deposit, interest, and maturity amount (EEE status).

general: Account opened by the natural/legal guardian in the name of a girl child
Girl child must be below 10 years of age at the time of account opening
Maximum two accounts per family (allowed for triplets/twins with certificate)
otherConditions: Deposit required for 15 years from account opening date; matures in 21 years

eligibilityChecks.question: Is the girl child below 10 years of age?
Are there no more than 2 existing SSY accounts opened in your family?

requiredDocuments: Birth Certificate of the Girl Child (mentioning child and parents' names)
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card of the Parent / Guardian
Address Proof (Passport / Voter ID / Utility Bill of Parent)
Passport size photographs of child and parent
applicationProcess: Visit any Post Office or authorized Commercial Bank branch (SBI, PNB, HDFC, ICICI, etc.)
Fill Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) Account Opening Form
Submit girl child birth certificate and guardian KYC documents
Receive SSY Passbook containing account number and deposit ledger

applicationWindow.details: Open anytime until child completes 10 years of age

ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Women and Child Development
aiContext: High-interest (8.2%) government small savings scheme for girl children below 10 years. Max ₹1.5L/year deposit with triple tax exemption (EEE) under Section 80C. Matures at 21 years.

faqs.question: What is the minimum and maximum deposit per year?
faqs.answer: Minimum deposit is ₹250 per year and maximum deposit is ₹1,50,000 per financial year.

faqs.question: Can funds be withdrawn for higher education?
faqs.answer: Yes, partial withdrawal up to 50% of the balance is permitted once the girl child turns 18 for higher education fees.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
beneficiaries: BPL / SC / ST / Most Backward Classes / PMAY Families
description: Provides deposit-free LPG gas connections along with free first refill and hotplate (stove) to women belonging to poor and deprived households across India.

benefit.description: Deposit-free LPG connection including security deposit of cylinder, regulator, safety hose, domestic gas consumer card, and installation charges. Plus ₹300 direct cash subsidy per 14.2 kg LPG cylinder directly to bank account for up to 12 refills annually.

general: Applicant must be an adult woman (18 years and above)
No other existing LPG connection in the same household
Must belong to SC/ST, PMAY (Gramin), Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), Forest Dwellers, Most Backward Classes, or 14-point declaration poor household
otherConditions: Migrant workers can apply with self-declaration for address proof

eligibilityChecks.question: Is the applicant an adult female (aged 18 or above)?
Does your household currently have NO other LPG connection from any OMC?
Does your family belong to BPL / Ration Card / SC / ST / PMAY poor category?

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card of Applicant and all adult family members listed in ration card
Ration Card / Family Composition Certificate (or self-declaration for migrants)
applicationProcess: Visit PMUY portal (pmuy.gov.in) or visit nearest Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas distributor
Submit Ujjwala 2.0 application form with KYC documents
Oil Marketing Company (OMC) verifies de-duplication across all 3 oil companies
Distributor installs LPG stove and gas cylinder at beneficiary's home with safety briefing

dependsOn: OMC de-duplication check and distributor delivery

ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
aiContext: Provides deposit-free LPG gas connection to adult women in poor households, free first refill + stove, and ₹300/cylinder DBT subsidy for up to 12 refills per year.

faqs.question: Do migrant workers need a local ration card to apply?
faqs.answer: No, under Ujjwala 2.0, migrants can submit a simple self-declaration for both family composition and address proof.

faqs.question: How much subsidy is credited per refill?
faqs.answer: A targeted subsidy of ₹300 per 14.2 kg LPG cylinder is credited directly to the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account for up to 12 refills per year.
